content.introduction: On October 2, 2026, the Nikkei 225 was up by 2203.00 points, or 3.30%, to 68,956.72, the Hang Seng was up by 89.70 points, or 0.37%, to 24,613.27, while the S&P/ASX 200 was down by 174.90 points, or 1.99%, to 8,614.40. The top gainers included Lasertec Corp, which rose by 4580.0 points, or 11.14%, to 45,710.0, and Advantest Corp., which increased by 3350.0 points, or 9.78%, to 37,610.0.
